what_it_pays_for: Followers pay a monthly price for subscriber-only stories, lives, reels and posts, plus a badge next to their comments. Recurring income from the audience you already have.

revenue_basis.unit: revenue per paying subscriber per month
revenue_basis.note: A function of how many followers convert and at what price point you set.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: Must meet the Partner Monetization Policies and stay compliant with Community Standards and Content Monetization Policies.
Must accept the Instagram Subscriptions Terms of Use.
